what_to_detect: A candidate casting a meld card (not part of a melded permanent) passes the static_prohibition check although a static prohibits the name of the card's back face, since that back face gives the card no characteristics.
near_miss: A candidate a name-prohibiting static stops because the name it chose is the card's front face's.
record_fields: the prohibiting static host's chosen name (gen-3 card chosen)
the candidate card's other-face lines (gen-3 lines, active false) or sidecar

what_to_detect: A resolution that returns cards of one type from a zone to the battlefield leaves a double-faced card in the zone when its front face is not of that type, since a card in a zone has only its front face's characteristics.
near_miss: A double-faced card whose front face is of the required type moves with the others.
record_fields: state entities in the origin zone: types, face_state

what_to_detect: A candidate whose targeting clause restricts by mana value has a legal target on the stack: a double-faced spell on the stack has the mana value of the face it was cast as.
near_miss: A candidate with no legal target because the spell on the stack has another mana value.

what_to_detect: A candidate whose targeting clause restricts by mana value has a legal target on the stack: a spell cast transformed from the graveyard has the mana value of its front face.
near_miss: A candidate with no legal target because the spell on the stack has another mana value.

what_to_detect: A candidate whose targeting clause restricts by card type has a legal target on the stack: a double-faced card cast as its back face is a spell of the back face's types.
near_miss: A candidate with no legal target because the spell on the stack is of another type.

what_to_detect: A permanent with its back face up has the mana value of its front face, as the snapshot's mana cost shows.
near_miss: A permanent with its front face up, whose mana value is its own.

what_to_detect: A permanent that is a copy of a back face has mana value 0, because its copiable values hold no mana cost.
near_miss: The original back-face permanent, whose mana value is its front face's.

what_to_detect: A permanent cast with its back face shows only the back face's characteristics, its mana value the back face's mana cost.
near_miss: A permanent cast with its front face, showing the front face's characteristics.

what_to_detect: A melded permanent has a mana value equal to the sum of its two front faces' mana values.
near_miss: A copy of a melded permanent, whose mana value is 0.

what_to_detect: A permanent that transformed (a face_change event, its gen-3 face_state changed) is still reached by an affects link from a floating effect F<ts> created before the transform: it is the same object and keeps the effects on it.
near_miss: A permanent that left the battlefield and returned is a new object that no floating effect created before it left reaches.
record_fields: gen-3 links affects from a floating effect F<ts>

what_to_detect: A resolution that returns a card from exile to the battlefield leaves a double-faced card in exile when its front face cannot be a permanent (an instant or sorcery), whatever its back face is.
near_miss: A double-faced card whose front face is a permanent type returns with the others.
record_fields: state entities in exile: types, face_state
